composeFull:
set -euo pipefail
command -v ffmpeg >/dev/null || (apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq ffmpeg >/dev/null)
W=$(mktemp -d) && cd "$W"
curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o clip.mp4 'https://s/f.mp4'
curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o hook.png 'https://s/hook.png'
curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o logo.png 'https://s/logo.png'
mkdir -p fonts
curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o fonts/caption.ttf 'https://s/font.ttf'
printf '%s' 'QUJD' | base64 -d > captions.ass
curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o endsrc.mp4 'https://s/end.mp4'
EC_W=$(ffprobe -v error -select_streams v:0 -show_entries stream=width -of csv=p=0 endsrc.mp4); EC_H=$(ffprobe -v error -select_streams v:0 -show_entries stream=height -of csv=p=0 endsrc.mp4)
if [ "$EC_H" -gt "$EC_W" ]; then ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -y -sseof -2.5 -i endsrc.mp4 -t 2.5 -c:v libx264 -preset veryfast -crf 16 -c:a aac endcard.mp4 && EC=1; else EC=0; fi
if [ "${EC:-0}" = 1 ] && [ "$(ffprobe -v error -select_streams a -show_entries stream=index -of csv=p=0 endcard.mp4 | wc -l)" -lt 1 ]; then EC_SILENT=1; fi
if [ "${EC:-0}" = 1 ] && [ "$(ffprobe -v error -select_streams a -show_entries stream=index -of csv=p=0 clip.mp4 | wc -l)" -lt 1 ]; then CLIP_SILENT=1; CLIP_D=$(ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of csv=p=0 clip.mp4); fi
T=$(ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of csv=p=0 clip.mp4 | awk '{ printf "%.2f", $1 * 0.250 }')
ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -y -ss "$T" -i clip.mp4 -frames:v 1 -vf scale=720:-2 -q:v 3 still0.jpg
curl -fsS --retry 3 -X PUT -H 'Content-Type: image/jpeg' -H 'x-upsert: true' --data-binary @still0.jpg 'https://s/s0' >/dev/null
T=$(ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of csv=p=0 clip.mp4 | awk '{ printf "%.2f", $1 * 0.750 }')
ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -y -ss "$T" -i clip.mp4 -frames:v 1 -vf scale=720:-2 -q:v 3 still1.jpg
curl -fsS --retry 3 -X PUT -H 'Content-Type: image/jpeg' -H 'x-upsert: true' --data-binary @still1.jpg 'https://s/s1' >/dev/null
END=$(ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of csv=p=0 clip.mp4 | awk '{ s = $1 - 1.6; printf "%.2f", (s < 0 ? 0 : s) }')
FILTER='[0:v]scale=1080:1920:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,crop=1080:1920,setsar=1,fps=30,ass=captions.ass:fontsdir=fonts,format=yuv420p[base];[1:v]crop=1000:300:40:1200,scale=900:-1:flags=lanczos,format=rgba,fade=t=in:st=0:d=0.4:alpha=1[hook];[base][hook]overlay=90:1100:shortest=1:enable='"'"'lt(t,@END@)'"'"'[v1];[2:v]scale=349:-1:flags=lanczos,format=rgba,fade=t=in:st=@END@:d=0.5:alpha=1[logo];[v1][logo]overlay=365:92:shortest=1:enable='"'"'gte(t,@END@)'"'"'[v2];[v2]format=yuv420p[v]'
FILTER="${FILTER//@END@/$END}"
if [ "${EC:-0}" = 1 ]; then ECIN="-i endcard.mp4"; ECN=3; if [ "${EC_SILENT:-0}" = 1 ]; then ECIN="$ECIN -f lavfi -t 2.5 -i anullsrc=r=48000:cl=stereo"; ECA="$((ECN + 1)):a"; CAN=$((ECN + 2)); else ECA="$ECN:a"; CAN=$((ECN + 1)); fi; if [ "${CLIP_SILENT:-0}" = 1 ]; then ECIN="$ECIN -f lavfi -t $CLIP_D -i anullsrc=r=48000:cl=stereo"; CA="$CAN:a"; else CA="0:a"; fi; END_F=';[v]setsar=1[vm];[@CA@]aformat=sample_rates=48000:channel_layouts=stereo[am];[@EC@:v]scale=1080:1920:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,crop=1080:1920,setsar=1,fps=30,format=yuv420p[ecv];[@ECA@]aformat=sample_rates=48000:channel_layouts=stereo[eca];[vm][am][ecv][eca]concat=n=2:v=1:a=1[vout][aout]'; END_F="${END_F//@EC@/$ECN}"; END_F="${END_F//@CA@/$CA}"; FILTER="$FILTER${END_F//@ECA@/$ECA}"; MAPS='-map [vout] -map [aout]'; else ECIN=""; MAPS='-map [v] -map 0:a?'; fi
set -f
ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -y -i clip.mp4 -loop 1 -i hook.png -loop 1 -i logo.png $ECIN -filter_complex "$FILTER" $MAPS -c:v libx264 -preset medium -crf 18 -pix_fmt yuv420p -r 30 -c:a aac -b:a 160k -movflags +faststart out.mp4
curl -fsS --retry 3 -X PUT -H 'Content-Type: video/mp4' -H 'x-upsert: true' --data-binary @out.mp4 'https://s/up?t=a'"'"'b' >/dev/null
echo "COMPOSED $(stat -c %s out.mp4) $(ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of csv=p=0 out.mp4) $(ffprobe -v error -select_streams a -show_entries stream=index -of csv=p=0 out.mp4 | wc -l)"
